from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReportRecord(BaseModel):
    """Credit impairment loss data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company whose financial report this is")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period covered (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="The credit impairment loss amount; None if not stated in this document")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency/unit of the amount (e.g., '元')")
    excerpt: str = Field(description="Source text containing the credit impairment loss value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_records: list[FinancialReportRecord]
